Why reviews matter

A review is word of mouth that stays.

Happy customers used to tell one neighbor. A Google review tells everyone who looks you up.

  • A vouch

    A real customer saying, in their own words, that you did the job right.

  • A vote

    97% of consumers use reviews to choose a local business (BrightLocal 2026).

  • It stays up

    It is there for every homeowner who looks you up, long after the van leaves.

Each review is one customer vouching to the next. We make sure every one of them gets asked.

Every review waits on someone remembering.

The job is done and the customer is happy. Then everyone is on to the next call.

  1. Today: some customers get asked.
  2. With Rempo: every completed job asked.

Whether a customer reviews is up to them. Asking every one is up to us.

94% of consumers are open to writing a local review (BrightLocal 2026).

Where reviews leak

Three leaks no report shows you.

Typical cases from home-service businesses, and what Rempo does about each.

  1. 01A typical case

    Happy customers who never got asked.

    A busy week. The link went out after some jobs, not others. Nobody chose to skip anyone. Everyone was on the next call.

    With Rempo: a request goes out after every completed job, once your software is connected. One reminder, then we stop.

  2. 02A typical case

    The 3-star review nobody answered.

    It posted on a Tuesday. Everyone meant to reply. It sat in public for weeks.

    With Rempo: you get an alert the day it posts, and a reply is written for what the customer said.

    3-star review posted Day 1Week 1Week 3 Still no reply

  3. 03A typical case

    The newest review is from spring.

    A homeowner with no heat checks you tonight. 74% of consumers look for reviews from the last three months (BrightLocal 2026).

    With Rempo: every completed job is asked, every week, so recent customers get the chance to review.

Get started

Rather talk it through first? Book a 15-minute call.

Straight answers.

What owners ask first, including the questions where the answer is no.

What is a Google review, exactly?

A customer's public note and star rating about your business, shown when people look you up on Google. 97% of consumers use reviews to choose a local business (BrightLocal 2026).

Do homeowners really read them?

Most do. 91% of homeowners rate online reviews important when choosing an HVAC contractor (ACHR News 2024).

Is Rempo software I have to run?

No. Rempo is a service. You do four things once, then our team runs it from the job software you already use. You see the work every month.

How is this different from asking customers myself?

Same idea, done every time: a thank-you after every completed job, one reminder, and a reply to every review. Nobody on your team has to remember.

Does it work with my job software?

We connect to the software you log jobs in as part of setup. Jobs on paper or in a spreadsheet? Book a 15-minute call and we'll talk it through.

What do I have to do?

Four things, once: connect your job software, give Google profile access, send one team photo, approve your texting details. After that, we run it.

When do requests start?

Email requests can start once your software is connected. Texts start once carrier registration clears, which usually takes about a week.

My job software already sends review requests.

That switch sends a request. Nobody runs it. We run the whole program: requests, one reminder, a reply written for each review, and a monthly report.

Will texts annoy my customers?

One request after the job and at most one reminder. Anyone can reply STOP and they won't hear from us again.

Is this allowed by Google?

Yes, the way we run it: the same request to everyone. No screening out unhappy customers, no rewards, no asking them to name a technician or what to write.

Can you remove a bad review?

No. You get an alert the day it posts, and a calm reply is written for it, so you can decide whether to call the customer first.

Will you guarantee more reviews or a higher ranking?

No. We control asking every customer and answering every review. How many review, and where Google ranks you, aren't ours to promise. We track both monthly.

Why not a cheaper review tool?

A tool is cheaper, and you run it. Rempo is a service that runs. If you'd rather run it yourself, a tool is the right call.
